test_reindex_preserves_tz_empty_target: test that DatetimeIndex.reindex preserves timezone when reindexing to an empty list or array
test_reindex_with_nearest_method: test DatetimeIndex.reindex with method='nearest' and a timedelta tolerance on UTC-indexed ranges
test_reindex_preserves_timezone: test that reindexing a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex to empty targets preserves the original timezone
test_reindex_nearest_matching: test DatetimeIndex.reindex with nearest matching using same timezone and tolerance parameter
test_reindex_return_values: test that DatetimeIndex.reindex returns a reindexed index and an integer array of matching positions
